node.statement: Exact missing bridge and required constant repair. For W in {U,V}, any permitted estimate ||Co^{A_R}_{P_W^R}(P_W^R)-P_W^R||<=K_unit*t with one universal K_unit would, by the triangle inequality and node 1.4, give ||T_W(I_{B_W})-P_W^R||<=(C_out+K_unit)*t at every amplification (the n-level statement follows from the fixed amplification/compression identities). Enlarging the existential witness to C_cross>=max{1,C_nest,C_out+K_unit,2*C_ca} and decreasing e_cross to the estimate threshold would then complete the diagonal-unit clause, while node 1.5 completes all zero-corner clauses. But no such K_unit estimate is among the shard-permitted definitions or seven registered externals: lem-compcb-corner-algebra identifies the corner unit as Co_P(P) without comparing it to P, and the two compression externals assert only amplification, idempotence, and dagger identities. Therefore this bridge must be provisioned as an additional allowed input (or proved in a separately factored registry lemma) before node 1.7 and the root can be proved.
